author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Am I the only one who thinks VSCode GitHub Copilot is better than Claude Code.
I have unlimited Claude tokens at work, I only have a $20 Copilot subscription at home.
At work I am pushing the absolute limit of what AI can do. At home, I just vibe coding fun side projects I have in the pile for decades.
I know Copilot can't handle the kind of task at work, but for those easy stuff that Opus can one shot generate, I found the user experience of VSCode is way better than Claude Code
I tried the Claude Code VSCode extension, it sucks.
